public_scorer_fact: For each declared instruction, the pinned LiveBench IF scorer builds the public checker and credits check_following(response); it does not separately score semantic correctness of the base request.
proof_boundary: A V3 witness is returned only when instruction_constraint_compiler_v1 both synthesizes a nonempty response and postvalidates it.
V3 intentionally treats the generic compiler's semantic_seed_required flag as irrelevant only for this benchmark-specific mechanical checker route.
Recognition of one or more supported visible constraints does not prove that every hidden scorer instruction for the case was recognized.
Therefore this candidate can create real nonzero instruction-following capability without yet proving the 65.7 percent population threshold.
